entry.content:
9.0.120 SR 12

What's Changed

.NET 9 SR12 introduces significant improvements across all platforms with focus on quality, performance, and developer experience. This release includes 104 commits with various improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements.

.NET MAUI Product Fixes

Android

  • [release/9.0.1xx-sr12] [Android] -Picker dialog causes crash when page is popped while dialo… by @github-actions[bot] in #31919

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] -Picker dialog causes crash when page is popped while dialo…

BlazorWebView

  • Replace UseStaticFiles() with MapStaticAssets() in Blazor Maui Web template by @Copilot in #31618

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Blazor][Maui] Use MapStaticAssets in the Blazor Maui Web template

  • Revert "Replace UseStaticFiles() with MapStaticAssets() in Blazor Maui Web template" by @mattleibow in #31676

    🔧 Fixes
    • Replace UseStaticFiles() with MapStaticAssets() in Blazor Maui Web template

  • Reland "Replace UseStaticFiles() with MapStaticAssets() in Blazor Maui Web template" by @mattleibow in #31677

    🔧 Fixes
    • Revert "Replace UseStaticFiles() with MapStaticAssets() in Blazor Maui Web template"

Button

  • Radio Button Null Selection Fix by @asi-evin in #31175

    🔧 Fixes
    • RadioButtonGroup.SelectedValue = null doesn't reset RadioButton IsChecked state

Collectionview

  • [iOS] Flyout Menu CollectionView First Item Misaligned - fix by @kubaflo in #30501

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Regression] [iOS] Flyout Menu CollectionView First Item Misaligned Since 9.0.51 (iOS 15–18.1 Affected, Works in 9.0.50)

  • [iOS] CV1 & CV2 - Support for RTL by @kubaflo in #27653

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS, Mac] CollectionView with a static string-based ItemsSource does not respect right-to-left (RTL) FlowDirection.
    • [iOS] FlowDirection = "RightToLeft" doesn't work with CV1 & CV2

  • [iOS] Support for KeepLastItemInView for CollectionView2 on iOS by @kubaflo in #31104

    🔧 Fixes
    • ItemsUpdatingScrollMode on CollectionViewHandler2
    • [.NET10]I9-Scroll mode "KeepLastItemInView" does not keep the last item at the end of the displayed list when adding new items.

  • Fix for Preventing Incorrect TalkBack Announcements During CollectionView Deselection on Android by @praveenkumarkarunanithi in #29818

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Accessibility] CollectionView Selected on Android

  • [iOS] Fixed the crash occurred on CarouselView2 when deleting last one remaining item with loop as false by @Ahamed-Ali in #31537

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] CarouselView with CarouselViewHandler2 make app crash when Loop="False" and user scroll to the last position - fix
    • [iOS] Fix CarouselView proper bounce-back behavior when Loop=false
    • [iOS] Crash occurred on CarouselView2 when deleting last one remaining item with loop as false

  • Fix Customised CollectionView inherited from does not ScrollTo and display selection correctly by @SuthiYuvaraj in #31549

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] - Customised CollectionView (inherited from) does not [ScrollTo] and display selection correctly

  • [iOS] CurrentItem does not work when PeekAreaInsets is set - fix by @kubaflo in #29995

    🔧 Fixes
    • [CarouselViewHandler2] CurrentItem does not work when PeekAreaInsets is set

  • [release/9.0.1xx-sr12] [iOS] Fix memory leak in CollectionViewHandler2 ItemsLayout PropertyChanged subscription by @github-actions[bot] in #31922

    🔧 Fixes
    • Fix memory leak in CollectionView and CarouselView by using instance-based ItemsLayout defaults

Controls Entry

  • [Android, iOS, MacOS] Fixed Entry ClearButton Color Not Updating on AppThemeBinding Change by @NanthiniMahalingam in #30817

    🔧 Fixes
    • Facing issues with the Entry, DatePicker, and CheckBox components when applying themes.
    • [iOS] Clear button does not apply TextColor when set at runtime

Controls Flyout

  • [Windows] Fixed Unstable order of Flyout Items with conditional visibility by @SubhikshaSf4851 in #29197

    🔧 Fixes
    • Unstable order of FlyoutItems with conditional visibility

  • [Windows, Catalyst] Fix IsPresented=true Not Working on Initial Value in FlyoutPage by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #31515

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows, Catalyst] IsPresented=true Not Working on Initial Value in FlyoutPage

Controls Searchbar

  • Fix SearchBar IsTextPredictionEnabled false functionality by @Shalini-Ashokan in #31255

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android, iOS] IsTextPredictionEnabled="False" for SearchBar not working

  • [Android] Fix SearchBar FlowDirection Property Not Working by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #30431

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] SearchBar FlowDirection Property Not Working on Android

  • [Android] SearchBar does not update colors on theme change - fix by @kubaflo in #30601

    🔧 Fixes
    • Theme issue on Search bar control in .NET MAUI
    • [Android] SearchBar does not update colors on theme change

Controls Titleview

  • [iOS] Shell/navigation page title view - respect the margin property by @kubaflo in #31701

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS] Navigation bar TitleView isn't rendered within the device's bounds.

Data Binding

  • [release/9.0.1xx-sr12] Fix ProjectList not displaying due to missing BindingContext update in template sample by @github-actions[bot] in #31954

    🔧 Fixes
    • Fix ProjectList not displaying due to missing BindingContext update in template sample

Drawing

  • [Windows] Allow to remove clip at runtime by @MartyIX in #31488

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] Fix performance issue using Shadows
    • [Windows] Allow to remove shadows at runtime

  • [Android] Sort gradient stops by offset by @kubaflo in #31318

    🔧 Fixes
    • LinearGradientBrush can not work

Entry

  • [release/9.0.1xx-sr12] [Android][Regression] Fixed Entry and Editor AppThemeBinding colors for text and placeholder reset to default on theme change by @github-actions[bot] in #31921

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android][Regression] Fixed Entry and Editor AppThemeBinding colors for text and placeholder reset to default on theme change

Gestures

  • [Windows] Test inclusion for the PointerGestureRecognizer issue in MultiWindow. by @Ahamed-Ali in #31143

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows]Fixed the PointerGestureRecognizer behaves incorrectly when multiple windows are open.

Infrastructure

  • [ci] Run xharness DeviceTests on dnceng-public Helix by @rmarinho in #30544

    • Run device tests on dnceng/helix

  • [ci] Inventory start by @rmarinho in #31593

  • [main] Update dependencies from dotnet/xharness by @dotnet-maestro[bot] in #31872

    • [ci] Update arcade main

  • Fixed System.ArgumentException when setting FlyoutLayoutBehavior dynamically [Windows] by @Dhivya-SF4094 in #31491

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] System.ArgumentException thrown when setting FlyoutLayoutBehavior dynamically

Navigation

  • [iOS] Fix Navigation Page BackButtonTitle Not Updating by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #31583

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS, macOS] Navigation Page BackButtonTitle Not Updating

  • [Android,Windows] Fix NavigatingFrom event order inconsistency with PushAsync by @Vignesh-SF3580 in #31536

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android, Windows] NavigatingFrom event order inconsistent across platforms with PushAsync

  • [iOS] Fix added for Navigation.SetTitleView does not work in ios 26. by @sheiksyedm in #31831

    🔧 Fixes
    • NavigationPage.TitleView content is not displayed on iPadOS 26 when built with Xcode 26
    • Navigation.SetTitleView does not work in ios 26

  • Invert NavigationPage UseMauiHandler flag by @drasticactions in #31859

Other

  • .NET 9 Release Branding by @PureWeen in #31545

  • [inflight/candidate] September 15th - Fix null reference in ItemsViewController flow direction by @kubaflo in #31603

  • [Testing] Fixed Test case failure in PR 31525 - [09/15/2025] Candidate by @TamilarasanSF4853 in #31611

  • Revert PR #30501 by @sheiksyedm in #31643

    • [Windows] Upgrade Windows App SDK from 1.7.3 to 1.7.4

  • Candidate Branch September 22nd by @PureWeen in #31681

  • 9.0.120 Release Branding by @PureWeen in #31979

Refreshview

  • [Windows] Fix RefreshView Command executes multiple times when IsRefreshing is set to True by @devanathan-vaithiyanathan in #31471

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] RefreshView Command executes multiple times when IsRefreshing is set to True

Shapes

  • [ci] Add back dnceng-public maui pipeline by @rmarinho in #31524

Shell

  • [iOS] Shell/NavigationPage TitleView by @kubaflo in #20959

    🔧 Fixes
    • Unnecessary Margin in TitleView
    • [Spec] Shell/NavigationPage TitleView
    • [iOS] Wrong default left/right margin in the navigation bar on iOS

  • Fix for exception thrown when disconnecting page handlers in the Unloaded event while navigating on MacCatalyst and iOS by @KarthikRajaKalaimani in #29410

    🔧 Fixes
    • Crash on shell navigation for Mac Catalyst

  • [Android] Shell BackButtonBehavior binding Command to valid ICommand causes back button to disappear by @kubaflo in #28132

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] Shell.FlyoutIcon doesn't show correctly.
    • [Android] Shell BackButtonBehavior binding Command to valid ICommand causes back button to disappear

TabbedPage

  • [iOS, Mac] TabbedPage overflow "More" button does not works by @kubaflo in #31385

    🔧 Fixes
    • [iOS, Mac] TabbedPage overflow "More" button does not works

  • [Android] Fixed incorrect tab content display in TabbedPage by @Vignesh-SF3580 in #27294

    🔧 Fixes
    • Android Tabbar, clicking 4th tab opens the 5th tab
    • [TabbedPage] PopToRootAsync displaying wrong page
    • TabbedPage: content not shown after readding

Theming

  • Fix NRE on GetSystemResources by @drasticactions in #31605

WebView

  • [Windows] Fix for FlowDirection="RightToLeft" causes mirrored content in WebView and HybridWebView by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #30709

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] FlowDirection="RightToLeft" causes mirrored content in WebView and HybridWebView

  • Temporarily disable flaky WebView tests using FlakyTest attribute by @Copilot in #31868

    🔧 Fixes
    • [testing] Re-enable disabled flaky UITests WebViewShouldNotMirrored & CookiesCorrectlyLoadWithMultipleWebViews

Windows

  • [Windows] Upgrade Windows App SDK from 1.7.3 to 1.7.4 by @MartyIX in #31667

  • [Windows] Optimize TextHighlighters use by @MartyIX in #31429

    🔧 Fixes
    • [WinUI] Creating a complex grid is very slow

  • Misc nativeAOT Windows stability adjustments by @morning4coffe-dev in #31274

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] Improve NativeAOT support

  • [Windows] Revert cleanup of AccessibilityExtensions by @MartyIX in #31608

    🔧 Fixes
    • MAUI 9.0.110 crashes on Windows when SemanticProperties.Description is set for ToolbarItem

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Windows] Build warnings mention WinAppSDK 1.6 but the used version is 1.7

  • Delete GlobalXmlns.cs from maui-mobile template by @jfversluis in #31730

    🔧 Fixes
    • add global xmlns in template

1.5.0-beta.1 (2025-10-16)

Features Added

  • Added mapping for enduser.pseudo.id attribute to user_Id

  • Added support for configuring sampling via OpenTelemetry environment
    variables:

    • OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER (supported values: microsoft.rate_limited,
      microsoft.fixed_percentage).
    • OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG (rate limit in traces/sec for
      microsoft.rate_limited, sampling ratio 0.0 - 1.0 for
      microsoft.fixed_percentage). This now applies to both
      UseAzureMonitorExporter and the direct
      Sdk.CreateTracerProviderBuilder().AddAzureMonitorTraceExporter(...) path.
      (#52720)

  • Added handling of stable database client span semantic conventions
    (#53050)

Azure.Monitor.Query.Metrics_1.0.0

1.0.0 (2025-10-15)

Features Added

This package contains the first release of Microsoft Azure Monitor Metrics Query client library. This library replaces metrics querying operations of the Azure.Monitor.Query package.

Azure.ResourceManager.StorageDiscovery_1.0.0

1.0.0 (2025-10-13)

Features Added

  • First stable (GA) release of Azure Storage Discovery client library.
  • API surface is now considered stable; no breaking changes since 1.0.0-beta.1.
  • Core features now generally available:
    • Out-of-the-box support for MSAL.NET authentication via Azure.Identity.
    • Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry.
    • Customizable HTTP pipeline with custom policies.
    • Improved error handling.
    • Uniform telemetry support across all languages.
  • For feedback or issues, please visit our Azure SDK for .NET GitHub repo.
